n: 30 Inch Professional Gas With Precision Knob Control In Stainless Steel
desc: The THOR Kitchen 30 Inch Professional Gas Range brings bold performance and refined control together to elevate your everyday cooking experience. Its high-powered 18,000 BTU burner delivers fast, intense heat for everything from quick weeknight meals to restaurant-quality dishes, while the spacious 4.55 cu. ft. oven easily accommodates large baking sheets, roasting pans, and multiple dishes at once.
hl: A tilt panel touch control is an adjustable control panel that tilts for optimal viewing and ease of use.
The continuous grate design allows easy movement of pots and pans across the cooktop.
Featuring a maximum output of 15,000 BTU for powerful cooking and a minimum of 650 BTU for precise, gentle simmering.
